title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: It is dangerous to swim in the river.
Bring an umbrella and a raincoat.
Don't worry. It is fine today.
There is a waterfall in the forest.
We go hiking on the trip.
The hotel is close to the lake.
The fog is heavy in the morning.
We should listen to the weather report.

plan.title: 跟读第 1–3 句
plan.task: 先听一遍，再跟读 3 遍

plan.title: 跟读第 4–6 句
plan.task: 先听一遍，再跟读 3 遍

plan.title: 跟读第 7–9 句
plan.task: 先听一遍，再跟读 3 遍

plan.title: 不看书，说给家长听
plan.task: 挑 5 句最喜欢的，尽量不看书说出来

plan.title: 自己说 3 句话
plan.task: 用 'It is … to …' 或 'Bring …' 说 3 句话给出旅行小提醒
